superseded_method.interpretation: The model loaded and ran but returned no usable caption. Independently of that failure, VLMs are trained on natural photographs and degrade on false-colour SAR and analytical figures, and CPU generation was impractically slow. A generative caption is also not auditable: for a preparedness product every sentence must trace to the numbers behind it.

assumptions: Narratives are assembled deterministically from the sub-district decision table. Every number traces to a field and every qualitative phrase is licensed by the versioned band table 'narrative_bands_v1'. No generative model is involved, so the text cannot fabricate. Planning language only; not an official warning.
